function.name: find_root_causes
function.description: FMEA root-cause analysis for a lot: follow its symptoms -causedBy-> causes -attributedTo-> parts, multiply the two edge confidences, return (cause, part, score) with score >= min_confidence (default 0.48).

function.name: trace_contamination
function.description: Contamination propagation from a defective component: partOf (transitive) up to its process chamber, then feedsInto (transitive) downstream; return the suspect lots processed in those chambers.

function.name: classify_sensor_anomalies
function.description: Parts within a production line whose latest SOSA observation exceeds the maxAllowedDrift of the specification their class references (owl:Restriction on ssn:hasProperty).

function.name: count_sensor_anomalies
function.description: Count all parts in the fab whose latest observation exceeds their specification.

function.name: add_superclass
function.description: SCHEMA (TBox) WRITE: make each listed existing class a subclass of a (possibly new) parent class and attach a required policy to that parent. Instance data is not modified.

function.name: list_equipment_by_class
function.description: List equipment whose type is the given class or any subclass, with the class policy.

function.name: batch_stream_update
function.description: Simulate a CDC batch: pick `count` random sensor observations and upsert new readings in ONE transaction.

function.name: check_sensor_threshold
function.description: Current reading(s) of a part and the threshold of its specification.
